findingDetails.title: The hub counts a cupt-only runtime as ClickUp tooling, so it promises a push the packet cannot perform
findingDetails.scopeProof: both halves ship in this repository: the trigger list and the packet's MCP-only table it routes to
findingDetails.claim: The hub's ClickUp handoff trigger includes a cupt-only runtime, while the packet documents task creation and document operations as MCP-only, so the offered push cannot be completed there.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the cupt reference and ten cupt feature-catalog areas for a create or document command, found none; checked whether Section 7 could be read as governing, found AGENTS.md states its own trigger set first.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: A cupt-only runtime could push by commenting on an existing task. That is real but is not the push the offer names (new task in a list link, or a private doc).
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If AGENTS.md is read as descriptive and Section 7 as the operative rule, the divergence is wording and the severity drops to P2.

findingDetails.title: The private-doc push recipe omits a required parameter and folds page creation into the create call
findingDetails.scopeProof: the recipe, the required-parameter table and the takes-no-content sentence are all inside this repository
findingDetails.claim: Section 7's private-doc recipe omits create_page, which the packet marks required, and describes content going into a call the packet says takes no content.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read the create-document card and the tool reference's document section for a variant where create_page is optional or content is accepted; found none and found an explicit takes-no-content sentence.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The schema may default create_page when omitted; even then the recipe produces an empty document before the page write and still misdescribes the call.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If a live call shows create_page is optional and content is accepted on create, the finding drops to P2 (wording).

findingDetails.scopeProof: the hub root has no mcp-tooling folder, and sibling references already use the vendored name

findingDetails.scopeProof: the restriction and the manifest are hub files; the disagreeing route is the packet's own RESOURCE_MAP
